hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '\.py$'; then FILE_DIR=$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"); PROJ=$(git -C "$FILE_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); PYTHON="$PROJ/.venv/bin/python"; if [ ! -f "$PYTHON" ]; then PYTHON=$(which python3); fi; "$PYTHON" -m ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; "$PYTHON" -m ruff format "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; BASENAME=$(basename "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" .py); TEST_FILE="$PROJ/tests/test_${BASENAME}.py"; if [ -n "$PROJ" ] && [ -f "$TEST_FILE" ]; then cd "$PROJ" && "$PYTHON" -m pytest "$TEST_FILE" -q --no-header 2>&1 | tail -5; fi; fi
